title: Little Red Barn Campground

services.name: Rental RVs
services.desc: Little Red Barn is so family-friendly... the owners will do anything to make your stay wonderful and to have you come back. It's all about the children! They keep it very updated as well. I can't say enough about Little Red Barn Campground. Tom and Vicki are so wonderful and everything is so clean. It's the best family-oriented campground around! My husband, niece & I spent a WONDERFUL weekend at the campground. It was so clean and well kept, but the best part was how nice and friendly everyone was. We had a GREAT time and made memories that will last a lifetime! This campground is clean and spacious. All the sites come with a fire pit and picnic table, and the pool is well-kept and clean.
